meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从日志、会话数据和挂载配置里排查容器代理启动或认证失败的根因
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果容器代理跑不起来或登录异常,想快速定位原因
copy.tagline_en: Trace container agent failures to root cause through logs, session data, and mount config
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your container agent won't run or fails to authenticate and you need the cause fast

howto.what: 装上后,机器人不回复、容器启动失败或认证出错时,Claude 会按这份指南带你查日志、会话数据库和挂载点,定位问题出在消息路由、投递还是容器运行环节。
howto.when: 当东西不正常工作、容器失败、认证出问题时触发,也可用于了解容器系统的运作方式,覆盖日志、会话数据库、挂载与常见故障。

say.text: 机器人突然不回消息了,帮我从日志查起
消息到了容器却没回复,查下会话数据库
容器一启动就退出,看它的 stderr 和退出码
say.note: 需把 LOG_LEVEL 调成 debug

howto.what_en: This skill walks you through debugging NanoClaw's containerized agent: checking logs, session DBs, and mounts to find out whether the trouble sits in routing, delivery, or the container run itself.
howto.when_en: Use when things aren't working, a container fails, or authentication breaks, and also to understand how the container system works. It covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

say_en.text: The bot stopped replying — help me trace it through the logs
The message reached the container but no reply came back
The container exits right away; look at its stderr and exit code
